thread:
kai: Heads-up — product wants to start sunsetting the old /v1/chat/completions endpoints next quarter. Can we sketch routing + quota impacts before we commit? :thinking:

ashley: Do we have a mapping of what clients still hit /v1 at scale? I can pull console usage, but need a list of tenant IDs to cross-check.

analyst-liz: I ran a quick query this morning: about 12% of active tokens in the last 30d come from v1-ish paths; rough skew toward smaller tenants and one mobile client. I can attach a CSV later.

kai: OK, important: we must avoid sudden quota drop spikes. Proposal: when we mark an app as "sunset-pending" in the console, route its v1 traffic to v2-compatible handler but keep quota accounting on the original quota bucket for 60 days. That buys time for clients. Thoughts?

mike: I worry about hidden contract differences — v2 has structured responses + function calling. If we proxy v1->v2 we need to transform outputs and ensure latency SLOs. Also batching behavior differs.

ashley: Agree. Maybe we only proxy simple generation calls (no functions, no streaming) for the compatibility window. For anything complex, return a 426-like advisory with migration hints.

kai: Good call. We'll need a routing policy rule: match path=/v1/chat/completions && tenant.tag=sunset-pending => route to compat-handler. Compat-handler should: 1) set header X-Compat-Proxy: v1-compat 2) keep quota_bucket = original 3) instrument telemetry for transform-rate, added-latency.

sara: Small note on telemetry: add a boolean metric compat_proxy=true and a histogram compat_transform_ms. Also tag whether the response was downgraded (e.g., functions -> plain text). We want to measure migration friction.

analyst-liz: Can we also emit a usage delta event so product can show "tokens billed to v1" vs "handled by compat" in the tenant dashboard? They asked for a countdown with exact cost delta.

mike: We should avoid double-billing. If we keep quota on original bucket, that's fine. But the backend model invocation still consumes compute; ensure billing attribution uses quota_bucket rather than request path.

kai: Right. Implementation checklist: 1) routing policy rule in edge config 2) compat-handler in runtime (transform + fallback) 3) console flag + per-tenant "sunset-pending" state 4) telemetry events and dashboard panels 5) quota mapping rule to keep billing continuity.

ashley: For console UX: show a banner on the tenant overview that says "Your app uses legacy endpoints — scheduled sunset on YYYY-MM-DD. Click for migration steps." Include an estimated cost delta and a one-click opt-in to auto-upgrade if the client uses only compatible features.

analyst-liz: I'll add a small card in the billing view showing tokens attributed to legacy endpoints vs modern endpoints and a forecast for the next 30d if no change.

mike: A few engineering constraints: compat transforms will add ~20-80ms median latency depending on response size; we should opt-in canary tenants first. Also, KV cache interaction — v2 uses prefix caching differently; compat-handler must disable aggressive prefix cache for proxied requests to avoid stale outputs.

kai: Good point. Let's list the safe default: disable prefix cache for proxied requests, add a header `X-Compat-Cache: disabled`. We can flip later if we see stable behavior.

ashley: Regarding quotas — we need a console control to override how long the accounting is kept on v1 bucket (default 60 days, min 7, max 180). Ops wants visibility if customers exceed quota during migration.

mike: We should also add a server-side feature flag `compat_proxy_enabled` per region so we can roll out region-by-region.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: compat-handler v0.1 -> eng-runtime-canary in us-west-2 at 5312346802.

kai: Sweet. Plan for telemetry dashboard: two panels — (a) compat proxy rate (requests/hr, tenants using it) (b) migration friction (pct downgraded, median extra latency). We should add an alert if downgraded_pct > 5% for top-10 tenants.

analyst-liz: I'll add the panels to the eng-platform dashboard and create a product-facing dashboard in the console. Do we want to push a weekly email to tenants still on v1?

ashley: Product will handle comms. For engineering: decide final routing rule DSL and land a migration doc. I'll draft the DSL change in PR and drop it here for review.

mike: If PR touches billing attribution, loop in finance for signoff.

kai: Action items:
- analyst-liz: CSV of tenant v1 usage + console card (due EOD Thu)
- ashley: PR for routing policy + console flag (due next Tue)
- mike: compat-handler perf plan + cache changes (due next Wed)
- sara: telemetry spec + alert thresholds (due next Tue)
- kai: schedule canary and prepare migration runbook (I'll do canary next Mon)

ashley: 👍 will ping when PR is up.

sara: Adding telemetry ticket to the sprint.

mike: Note: don't forget to update SDK docs for the migration path snippet.

kai: Thanks all. If no strong objections, we'll proceed with canary and hold final sunset date until after a two-week canary window. :eyes:
